nodes.label: Design System Inspired by Pacman
nodes.rationale: Retro arcade-inspired design with pixel fonts, dotted borders, playful high-contrast colors, and 8-bit game aesthetics; intent is to keep outputs recognizable to the style family while preserving usability and readability.

nodes.label: Pacman Color Palette

nodes.label: Pacman Typography System
nodes.rationale: Families: Press Start 2P (primary/display), Space Mono (mono). Headings carry style personality; body text optimizes scanability and contrast.
